assumptions.statement: The submitted SITE_BOUNDARY is the repository-maintained provisional rough polygon, marked official_boundary=false and used only for generation, visualization, intake checks, and design discussion.
assumptions.impact: Official geometry must replace it; land use, green space, public space, buildings, routes, phasing, drawings, and all derived metrics must then be recalculated.

assumptions.statement: The three KEY_AREA polygons are provisional rough geometries; only their official announcement names and approximate area values are authoritative at present.
assumptions.impact: Detailed-area layouts remain directional concepts and require full recomputation after official polygons are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Project-specific FAR, building height, approved building density, statutory green ratio, setbacks, road redlines, ownership, municipal capacity, and engineering constraints are not available in the public package.
assumptions.impact: The proposal records these controls as unknown and does not convert conceptual diagrams into statutory or engineering conclusions.

assumptions.statement: ROAD_CENTERLINE features are conceptual public-space and slow-mobility relationships rather than surveyed or approved alignments.
assumptions.impact: Widths, crossings, station interfaces, traffic organization, accessibility, and construction feasibility require official data and transport review.

assumptions.statement: Parcel boundaries and ownership conditions are not included, so the land-use partition is a continuous concept layer rather than a parcel-by-parcel proposal.
assumptions.impact: Project packaging, responsibility, and any parcel action must be determined only after cleared parcel and ownership information is available.

assumptions.statement: BUILDING_FOOTPRINT features represent twelve conceptual public interfaces and test-support prototypes, not surveyed existing buildings or confirmed new construction.
assumptions.impact: Retain, renovate, remove, or add decisions remain a method and review sequence; building quantities and footprints cannot support approval or investment decisions.

assumptions.statement: Exact heritage protection areas, construction-control zones, and implemented park boundaries are not present in the public package.
assumptions.impact: Heritage interventions are limited to reversible interpretation, signage, learning, and public-operation concepts pending specialist heritage review.

assumptions.statement: Drainage, power, gas, heat, communications, fire access, flood control, and utility-capacity data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Edge-computing, energy, robot, lighting, and waterfront-service ideas remain test briefs rather than infrastructure designs.

assumptions.statement: Baseline capacity and distribution data for education, health, eldercare, sports, culture, and community services are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Public-service scenarios focus on navigation, interface quality, and human fallback; no facility capacity or service-volume claim is made.

assumptions.statement: The Civic AI Covenant, annual events, public register, audit cycle, operation roles, and sunset clauses are proposed governance mechanisms.
assumptions.impact: They require human, legal, financial, organizational, and public-participation review before any trial; the proposal does not present them as scheduled arrangements.
